beats.description: Deliver Erin's package to Selys at the Adventurer's Guild.
Decide what to do with Selys's reward.
Find out what happened to Krshia's missing crate near the south-square sewers.
Tell Krshia what became of her crate.

quests._comment: Content Wave C3 Quest 1, three-path parity (crate precedent). Beat 1 `resolve` is the SHARED convergence counter `resolved_the_cisterns`, banked by ANY path: FIGHT (shield_spiders on_victory), TALK (Zevara sweep option), or SKILL (banked at Olesm's intel-report, since [Observe] alone only banks scouted_the_nest). Beat 2 `report` (`cisterns_reported`) is Olesm's completion, banked at report time on all three paths (the SKILL report banks resolve+report together, firing both beats at once -- crate guile precedent). heard_about_cisterns (the grate-gate + quest-start) is NOT a beat; it only opens the door.
quests.title: Something in the Cisterns

beats.description: Settle whatever has nested in the cisterns beneath the market -- however you see fit.
Report the outcome to Olesm at the Guild.
